A calm shift ahead, an important reminder
The subject is route planning
Travelers, please check your pet travel plans with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the gate.

Pet travel notice

Our team is here to help keep journeys smooth and safe for every traveler and companion animal. <<FACT F022>> Please allow extra room in your plans so we can review documents, carrier fit, and any special care notes before departure.

Aurelia Skyways treats each journey as a shared responsibility, and clear planning helps us avoid delays at the skyport. <<FACT F009>> If you are carrying a pet for the first time, or if your travel plans have changed, speak with us early so we can guide you through the next steps.

For calm, clear support, please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
